sloka: तेन पाप अनुबन्धेन वचनम् न प्रतीच्छता ।एवम् ब्रुवंत्यः सर्वाः स्म वायुना अभिहता भृषम् ॥१-३३-४॥
transliteration: tena pāpa anubandhena vacanam na pratīcchatā ।evam bruvaṁtyaḥ sarvāḥ sma vāyunā abhihatā bhṛṣam ॥1-33-4॥

translations.english: As all of us were speaking thus, the sinful Windgod, disregarding our words repeatedly assaulted us.
